speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I see you are experiencing fatigue and difficulty concentrating. To understand your condition, have you noticed any unexplained weight loss, night sweats, or persistent fevers?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those symptoms of dizziness and digital pain improving with cold are very specific; does the pain feel like it's in your fingers or toes? Given your history of smoking and these symptoms, have you noticed any changes in your skin color, such as turning white or blue?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and difficulty to concentrate. I also have Dyspnea on exertion, Dizziness, Digital pain that improves with cold.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Buerger's Disease (Thromboangiitis Obliterans)

The combination of digital pain relieved by cold (Lhermitte's sign equivalent in extremities), dyspnea, fatigue, and your history of heavy smoking strongly suggests Buerger's disease. REQUEST TEST: ANGIOGRAPHY of upper and lower extremities to confirm segmental vessel occlusions. REQUEST IMAGES: Please provide images of the angiogram showing the characteristic "corkscrew" collaterals and distal cutoffs.
